abilities.effect: This unit can move 3". If it can move into combat, it must. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: BEAST
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: BURNING UP
abilities.effect: Each time this MANIFESTATION uses a SHOOT ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this MANIFESTATION (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: CRUSHING BONEBULK
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy non-MONSTER unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll 2D6. Then, your opponent must roll a dice. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the two rolls.
This unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BATTLEFIELD ENHANCEMENTS
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect:
If an enemy HERO or MONSTER was destroyed by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, pick 1 of this unit’s melee weapons to be the target weapon.
Roll a D3. Add the result to the Attacks characteristic of the target weapon for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: ARCANE PASSAGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD within 3" of this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-SUMMON SPELL ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this MANIFESTATION instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this MANIFESTATION instead of to the caster for the purposes of the ‘Unbind’ ability.

abilities.name: MULTIPLE PARTS
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this MANIFESTATION’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this MANIFESTATION is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: VOICE OF NAGASH
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any non-CORE abilities used by other enemy units for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: MORTAL CONTRACT
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use a CORE ability, roll a D3 as a reaction. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target is destroyed by this ability, do not resolve the effect of that CORE ability.

abilities.name: URGENT MISSIVE
abilities.effect: Units in this Regiment of Renown can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on units in this Regiment of Renown by RETREAT abilities.

abilities.name: HOLY BLADES OF BONE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is CAVALRY. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: ROYAL APPROVAL
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly NOBLES or ABHORRANTS.

warscrolls.name: Marrowscroll Herald
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Royal Attendant.

abilities.name: THE KING’S ENTREATY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or reject the entreaty offered by this unit.
Accept: The target has the INFECTED keyword for the rest of the battle.
Reject: The target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: INFECTED
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a command, SPELL ability or PRAYER ability for an INFECTED unit
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 5+:
If they declared a command, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
If they declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability, that spell or prayer fails.
This reaction can be used more than once per phase but only once per command, SPELL ability or PRAYER ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a command, SPELL ability or PRAYER ability for an INFECTED unit

abilities.name: TO OUR LIEGE!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of a friendly FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect:
While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: MERCENARY ATTITUDES
abilities.declare: Pick another friendly non-UNIQUE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn and while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit:
You can re-roll run rolls for the target.
Add 1 to charge rolls for the target.
The target cannot be targeted by shooting attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 10 to the target’s control score.

abilities.name: SUMMON SOULSTEALER CARRION
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulstealer Carrion on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Soulstealer Carrion wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON BONE-TITHE SHRIEKER
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Bone-tithe Shrieker on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Bone-tithe Shrieker wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SUMMON NIGHTMARE PREDATOR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Nightmare Predator on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Nightmare Predator wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: ALL THE RAGE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a pair of objectives to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the target is the coveted pair of objectives instead of the other pair of objectives.

abilities.name: SUPPLIES DONT COME CHEAP
abilities.declare: Pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown. Each friendly unit wholly within 3" of that terrain feature is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, Heal (X) the target, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

abilities.name: NO ONE RIDES FOR FREE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly INFANTRY unit with up to 10 models that is wholly within 9" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: LONG-RANGE SUPPORT
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 15" of the Codewright in this Regiment of Renown and that no friendly units are contesting. Each unit contesting that objective is a target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SPECIALIST GRUNDSTOK AMMUNITION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.declare: Pick Shieldbreaker ammunition or Thunderdrakk ammunition.
abilities.effect:
If all of the attacks made for that SHOOT ability target the same enemy unit, after that SHOOT ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that SHOOT ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:
Shieldbreaker: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.
Thunderdrakk: That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

warscrolls.name: Codewright
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Guild Officer.

abilities.name: ADVISORY ROLE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly SKYFARERS units to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:
Seek New Prospects: Add 5 to the target’s control score.
Don’t Argue with the Wind: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
There’s No Trading With Some People: The target can use a RETREAT ability and still use SHOOT abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by RETREAT abilities.

abilities.name: DARK HUNT
abilities.effect: In your charge phase, if this unit is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn, it must use the ‘Charge’ ability, and if the charge roll would allow it to end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit, it must do so.

abilities.name: RAVENOUS SHRIEKS
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed by this unit’s shooting attacks, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Death Shriek for the rest of the battle (this effect is cumulative).

abilities.name: SHRIEK OF TERROR
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy INFANTRY unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more damage points are allocated to the target by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: WICKED PREDATOR
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For each champion, standard bearer and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Skeletal Talons, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: NECROMANTIC LIMITS
abilities.effect:
This unit’s Skeletal Talons have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.
While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Skeletal Talons is 4.

abilities.name: DETERMINED DEFENDERS
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly units while they are wholly outside enemy territory.

abilities.name: SECURE THE GATEWAY
abilities.effect: While you control the Place of Power wholly within friendly territory, friendly units’ melee weapons have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: SUMMON HORROR OF THE NECROPOLIS
abilities.declare:
Pick a friendly NULL MYRIAD WIZARD to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Soulstealer Carrion
Bone-tithe Shrieker
Nightmare Predator
abilities.effect: Set up the MANIFESTATION you picked wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: AURA OF ENERVATION
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly NULL MYRIAD units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: GOTHIZZAR CARTOUCHE
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly NULL MYRIAD units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: REINFORCE CONSTRUCT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly NULL MYRIAD WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly NULL MYRIAD unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: The target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: UNEARTHLY AURA
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly NULL MYRIAD WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly NULL MYRIAD unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: SUPERNATURAL ABSORPTION
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy MANIFESTATION within a friendly NULL MYRIAD unit’s combat range to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
The target is banished and removed from play.
If that friendly unit is damaged, Heal (X) that friendly unit, where X is the target’s Health characteristic.
If that friendly unit is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to X, where X is the target’s Health characteristic.

abilities.name: ARCANE IMMUNITY
abilities.effect: Friendly NULL MYRIAD units have WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

abilities.name: FIRST OF THE MORTARCHS
abilities.effect:
Each time you make a casting roll for a friendly Arkhan the Black, if all the following are true, that spell cannot be unbound:
The unmodified casting roll contains 2 or more results of the same value.
The casting roll equals or exceeds the spell’s casting value.
The spell is not miscast.

abilities.name: TO THE SHIPS!
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick the Heldenhain or a Sun Seekers objective to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield.

abilities.name: DEATHLESS MONSTROSITY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this unit

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Draconic Claws is 5.

abilities.name: DEATH ON TATTERED WINGS
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit in reserve high above the battlefield. It has now been deployed.

abilities.name: LOATHSOME DESCENT
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is high above the battlefield.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: RED RUIN
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Roll a D3. On a 2+, resolve the following effects:
Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
Heal (X) this unit where X is an amount equal to the roll.
This unit can be removed from the battlefield and set up in reserve high above the battlefield.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE CACHE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit contesting an objective you control to be the target.
abilities.effect: Give the target an emberstone sliver.

abilities.name: EMBERSTONE-AUGMENTED WEAPONS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn and has any emberstone slivers to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
Then, if you are the underdog, remove all of the target’s emberstone slivers. Otherwise, remove all emberstone slivers from each friendly unit.

abilities.name: GRIM SENTINELS
abilities.effect: Melee weapons used by friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend) while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.

abilities.name: SUMMON KRONDSPINE INCARNATE OF GHUR
abilities.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur on the battlefield, pick a friendly WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: REDEPLOY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Each model in that unit can move up to D6". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.

abilities.name: AT THE DOUBLE
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a RUN ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that RUN ability.
Do not make a run roll as part of that RUN ability. Instead, add 6" to that unit’s Move characteristic to determine the distance each model in that unit can move as part of that RUN ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a RUN ability

abilities.name: ALL-OUT ATTACK
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability. This also affects weapons that have the Companion weapon ability. For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the unit using this ability.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: FORWARD TO VICTORY
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can re-roll the charge roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: You declared a CHARGE ability

abilities.name: COUNTER-CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can use a CHARGE ability as if it were your charge phase.

abilities.name: GUARDED HERO
abilities.effect:
If this HERO(not MONSTER or WAR MACHINES) is within the combat range of a friendly unit that is not a HERO:
Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this HERO.
If this HERO is INFANTRY, they cannot be picked as the target of shooting attacks made by models more than 12" from them.

abilities.name: CHAMPION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of weapons used by champions in this unit. If this unit is a BEAST, this ability affects this unit’s Companion weapons.

abilities.name: DEPLOY FACTION TERRAIN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly faction terrain feature that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target faction terrain feature wholly within friendly territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: DEPLOY REGIMENT
abilities.declare: Pick a regiment from your army roster to be the target. No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.
abilities.effect: Keep using DEPLOY abilities without alternating until all units in that regiment have been deployed. You cannot set up units that are not in that regiment on the battlefield or in reserve as part of any of those Deploy abilities.

abilities.name: DEPLOY UNIT
abilities.declare: Pick a unit from your army roster that has not been deployed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Set up the target unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

abilities.name: ALL-OUT DEFENCE
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A unit targeted by that ATTACK ability.
Add 1 to save rolls for that unit until that ATTACK ability has been resolved.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability

abilities.name: SHOOT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat and has not used a RUN or RETREAT ability this turn to use this ability. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so, the unit using this ability has charged.

abilities.name: FIGHT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat or that charged this turn to use this ability. That unit can make a pile-in move (see 15.3). Then, if that unit is in combat, you must pick one or more enemy units as the target(s) of that unit’s attacks (see 16.0).
abilities.effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s).

abilities.name: NORMAL MOVE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RUN
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Make a run roll of D6. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the run roll. That unit cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: RETREAT
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit. That unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. That unit can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move within an enemy unit’s combat range.

abilities.name: MAGICAL INTERVENTION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability.
abilities.effect: That friendly unit can use a SPELL, PRAYER or BANISH ability (as appropriate) as if it were your hero phase. If you do so, subtract 1 from casting rolls or chanting rolls made as part of that ability.

abilities.name: RALLY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Make 6 rally rolls of D6. For each 4+, you receive 1 rally point. Rally points can be spent in the following ways:
For each rally point spent, Heal (1) that unit.
You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to that unit.
You can spend the rally points in any combination of the above. Unspent rally points are then lost.

abilities.name: STANDARD BEARER
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any standard bearers, add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: FLY
abilities.effect: As this unit moves, it ignores other models, terrain features and the combat ranges of enemy units. It cannot end its move in combat unless specified in the ability that allowed it to move. Ignore any vertical distance moved for this unit.

abilities.name: WARD SAVE
abilities.effect: In step 1 of the damage sequence (see 18.0), make a ward roll of D6 for each damage point in this unit’s damage pool. If the roll equals or exceeds this unit’s ward value, remove that damage point from the damage pool.

abilities.name: BANISH MANIFESTATION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly WIZARD or PRIEST to use this ability, pick a MANIFESTATION within 30" of them that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the banishment roll for each additional enemy MANIFESTATION on the battlefield after the first. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

abilities.name: SACRED RITES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly PRIEST to use this ability, then make a chanting roll of D6. On an unmodified chanting roll of 1, remove 1 ritual point from that PRIEST instead of D3.
abilities.effect: Give a number to ritual points to the PRIEST equal to the unmodified chanting roll and do not reset the PRIEST’s ritual points to 0.

abilities.name: POWER THROUGH
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then you must pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The target must have a lower Health characteristic than the unit using this ability.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, the unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through and end that move within the combat ranges of enemy units that were in combat with it at the start of the move, but not those of other enemy units. It does not have to end the move in combat.

abilities.name: MUSICIAN
abilities.effect: While this unit contains any musicians, if it uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make one additional rally roll of D6.

abilities.name: UNBIND
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly WIZARD within 30" of the enemy WIZARD casting the spell.
Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, then the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved. This reaction cannot be used more than once per casting roll.

extra.reactionTrigger: Opponent declared a SPELL ability

abilities.name: COVERING FIRE
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit that did not use a RUN ability this turn and that is not in combat to use this ability, then pick the closest enemy unit (to that unit) that can be picked as the target of shooting attacks to be the target. You cannot pick MANIFESTATIONS or faction terrain features as the target of this ability.
abilities.effect: Resolve shooting attacks for the unit using this ability against the target. You must subtract 1 from the hit rolls for those attacks.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE PLACE OF POWER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HERO within 3" of any Places of Power to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on that HERO. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:
Ignite Fury: Gain 2 rage dice, then increase your fury level by 2, to a maximum of 7.
Channel Wrath: If that HERO is a WIZARD or PRIEST, add 1 to casting rolls or chanting rolls for that HERO for the rest of the turn.
Dizzying Rage: For the rest of the turn, if that HERO is not a WIZARD or PRIEST, they can use the ’Unbind’ or ’Banish Manifestation’ ability as if they had WIZARD (1).

abilities.name: ENEMY OF THE THRONE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown for attacks that target a SENTENCED unit.

abilities.name: ETHEREAL
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for units in this Regiment of Renown.

warscrolls.name: Scriptor Mortis
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Cursed Soul.

abilities.name: JUDGE, JURY AND EXECUTIONER
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY unit uses a FIGHT ability, if all of its attacks target the same SENTENCED enemy unit, that friendly unit’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for that FIGHT ability.

abilities.name: SENTENCED TO ETERNAL TORMENT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and the target has the SENTENCED keyword for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: BLACK-HEARTED LACKEYS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, this unit immediately uses the ’Retreat’ ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it. Then, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: AMULET OF GNOSIS
abilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly OSSIARCH B0NEREAPERS units by RETREAT abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

abilities.name: BLADE OF THE NADIR
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s non-Companion melee weapons. For the rest of the battle, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made with that weapon, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: SHARD OF NECRIS
abilities.effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4 and this unit did not charge in the same turn, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

abilities.name: IMMORTAL ELITE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HEROES on the battlefield. Pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO to be the target.
abilities.effect: You gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to the number after the target’s RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent relentless discipline points are lost.

abilities.name: INVIOLATE LEGIONS
abilities.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
abilities.effect:
Used By: A friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS unit targeted by that ATTACK ability. Friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS units can use this ability more than once per phase.
Spend 1 relentless discipline point. That unit has WARD (5+) against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that ATTACK ability.

abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: FORTRESS WREKKA
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You delcared the ‘Rip It Up and Chuck It’ ability for the unit in this Regiment of Renown
abilities.effect: After picking the target for that ability, roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 4+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the unit in this Regiment of Renown’s Hurled Boulder for the rest of the turn.

warscrolls.name: Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant
notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an Eager Lout.

abilities.name: BATTLE DAMAGED
abilities.effect: While this unit has 15 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Fortcrusha Flail is 11 for Calamitous Sweep and 4 for Crushing Blow.

abilities.name: PRIMAL RECKONING
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Fortcrusha Flail: Crushing Blow for each friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit that has been destroyed this battle, to a maximum of 10.

abilities.name: FORTCRUSHA FLAIL
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a FIGHT ability, pick either the Calamitous Sweep or Crushing Blow weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Fortcrusha Flail.

abilities.name: RIP IT UP AND CHUCK IT
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit that is not uprooted, then pick a friendly SONS OF BEHEMAT unit within 3" of that terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Make a rampage roll of D6. On a 3+:
If the target is another BIG unit, excluding Gatebreaker Mega-Gargants, it is armed with a Hurled Boulder for the rest of the turn (see the weapon profile on this unit’s warscroll. Modifiers to this unit’s ranged weapons or shooting attacks do not apply to the target).
If the target is a Gatebreaker Mega-Gargant or a LITTLE unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
That terrain feature is uprooted for the rest of the battle. If it is FACTION TERRAIN, inflict an amount of mortal damage on it equal to the rampage roll.

abilities.name: SPREADING WARPFIRE
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: If there are no flaming terrain features on the battlefield, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature to be the target. Otherwise, pick a non-FACTION TERRAIN terrain feature that is not flaming and that is within 12" of a flaming terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target is flaming for the rest of the battle. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on each unit (friendly and enemy) within 6" of any flaming terrain features.
